verses.text: Et congregávit Apollónius gentes, et a Samaría virtútem multam et magnam ad bellándum contra Israël.
Et cognóvit Judas, et éxiit óbviam illi: et percússit, et occídit illum: et cecidérunt vulneráti multi, et réliqui fugérunt.
Et accépit spólia eórum: et gládium Apollónii ábstulit Judas, et erat pugnans in eo ómnibus diébus.

responsory.text: Congregáti sunt inimíci nostri, et gloriántur in virtúte sua: cóntere fortitúdinem illórum, Dómine, et dispérge illos:

responsory.text: Dispérge illos in virtúte tua, et déstrue eos, protéctor noster, Dómine.

verses.text: Et audívit Seron princeps exércitus Sýriæ, quod congregávit Judas congregatiónem fidélium, et ecclésiam secum,

Et præparávit se: et ascendérunt cum eo castra impiórum fortes auxiliárii ut fácerent vindíctam in fílios Israël.

verses.text: Et appropinquavérunt usque ad Béthoron: et exívit Judas óbviam illi cum paucis.
Ut autem vidérunt exércitum veniéntem sibi óbviam, dixérunt Judæ: Quómodo potérimus pauci pugnáre contra multitúdinem tantam, et tam fortem, et nos fatigáti sumus jeiúnio hódie?
Et ait Judas: Fácile est conclúdi multos in manus paucórum: et non est differéntia in conspéctu Dei cæli liberáre in multis, et in paucis.

email.html:
Et congregávit Apollónius gentes, et a Samaría virtútem multam et magnam ad bellándum contra Israël.

Matins · Tuesday, 13 October 2026

Tuesday of the Twentieth Week after Pentecost

Feria Tertia infra Hebdomadam XX post Octavam Pentecostes · Feria

Read in Latin and English

Lesson I

De libro primo Machabæórum

1 Mac 3:10-12

Et congregávit Apollónius gentes, et a Samaría virtútem multam et magnam ad bellándum contra Israël. Et cognóvit Judas, et éxiit óbviam illi: et percússit, et occídit illum: et cecidérunt vulneráti multi, et réliqui fugérunt. Et accépit spólia eórum: et gládium Apollónii ábstulit Judas, et erat pugnans in eo ómnibus diébus.

℟. Our enemies are gathered together, and make their boast of their own strength. O Lord, break their power, and scatter them * That they may know that there is none other that fighteth for us, but only Thou, O our God!

℣. Scatter them in thy strength, and destroy them, O Lord our Shield.

℟. That they may know that there is none other that fighteth for us, but only Thou, O our God!

Lesson II

1 Mac 3:13-15

Et audívit Seron princeps exércitus Sýriæ, quod congregávit Judas congregatiónem fidélium, et ecclésiam secum, Et ait: Fáciam mihi nomen, et glorificábor in regno, et debellábo Judam, et eos qui cum ipso sunt, qui spernébant verbum regis. Et præparávit se: et ascendérunt cum eo castra impiórum fortes auxiliárii ut fácerent vindíctam in fílios Israël.

℟. Be ye not afraid of the assault of the enemy; remember how our fathers were delivered. * Now, therefore, let us cry unto heaven, and our God will have mercy upon us.

℣. Remember His marvellous works that He hath done unto Pharaoh and his host in the Red Sea.

℟. Now, therefore, let us cry unto heaven, and our God will have mercy upon us.

Lesson III

1 Mac 3:16-18

Et appropinquavérunt usque ad Béthoron: et exívit Judas óbviam illi cum paucis. Ut autem vidérunt exércitum veniéntem sibi óbviam, dixérunt Judæ: Quómodo potérimus pauci pugnáre contra multitúdinem tantam, et tam fortem, et nos fatigáti sumus jeiúnio hódie? Et ait Judas: Fácile est conclúdi multos in manus paucórum: et non est differéntia in conspéctu Dei cæli liberáre in multis, et in paucis.

℟. The sun shone upon the shields of gold, and the mountains glistered therewith; * And the army of the heathens was spread abroad.

℣. For the army was very great and mighty then Judas and his host drew near and entered into battle.

℟. And the army of the heathens was spread abroad.

℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

℟. And the army of the heathens was spread abroad.

Read in Latin and English

Dominican Breviary, 1962. Texts from Divinum Officium (divinumofficium.com).
